reasoning: Both attempts halve the values correctly, use auto layout, and are wired to live HudData. A builds the card's two drop shadows as native UIShadows with the right values. B replaces them with one 9-slice placeholder image, so the second shadow is missing and the shadow depends on art that doesn't exist yet. A's fault is setting ScreenInsets = DeviceSafeInsets, which can put the pill under the top bar. That is one property to change, while B's shadows need rebuilding, so A wins.

criteria.note: HudTheme and QuestCard halve everything: WIDTH 360, PADDING 16, GAP 8, Radii.Card 16, Title 24, Body 16, Count 16, pill HEIGHT 44 with Coins 24.

The card uses AnchorPoint (1,0) at (1,-24,0,80) and the pill (0.5,0) at (0.5,0,0,20), but Main sets ScreenInsets = DeviceSafeInsets, which skips the top-bar inset, and its comment says it does this on purpose.

Vertical UIListLayout with Padding 8, UIPadding 16, and AutomaticSize Y; the body is TextWrapped with LineHeight 24/16 = 1.5; the track uses UIFlexItem Fill; the title has a fixed computed width, and UISizeConstraint caps truncate long text.
Card gradient at default Rotation 0 on a white base, fill gradient at Rotation 90 on white, Transparency.Card 0.06, card stroke 2 px Center at 0.86, and a 2 px Contextual UIStroke on the coin text.
Two UIShadows: Offset (0,4) with BlurRadius 12 at 0.65, and Offset (0,1) with BlurRadius 2 at 0.8.
The fill is a native frame sized from the ratio (UDim2.new(ratio, ...)) and updates reactively; the pill is a plain fill at 0.4; only the coin and quest icons are images.
Live HudData through sources and a cleaned-up Changed connection; all checks pass; the safe-area opt-out is the one placement problem.
WIDTH 360, PADDING 16, GAP 8, CORNER_RADIUS 16, text sizes 24/16/16, pill HEIGHT 44 with TEXT_SIZE 24.
The card is at AnchorPoint (1,0), (1,-24,0,80) and the pill at (0.5,0), (0.5,0,0,20); ScreenInsets is left at its default, so the top bar stays clear.

Vertical list with Padding 8, UIPadding 16, and AutomaticSize Y; the body is wrapped with LineHeight 24/16; the title uses UDim2.new(1, -(ICON+GAP)); the track uses Fill; text is capped at 2 title lines and 5 body lines.
Card gradient at Rotation 0 on a white base at 0.06, fill gradient at Rotation 90, card stroke 2 px Center at 0.86, and a 2 px UIStroke on the coin text (default mode is Contextual).
No UIShadow: one 9-slice ImageLabel from rbxassetid://0 replaces both shadows, and the 1 px shadow is missing.
The fill is native, uses fromScale(fraction), and is reactive, and the pill is a plain 0.5 fill; but the shadow is an image and the glow is a separate placeholder image.
Live HudData and placement work and all checks pass; the shadow renders as nothing until art exists; the count does not clamp progress.

strengths: Every value halved correctly, with shared tokens in HudTheme
Explicit Contextual stroke and correct gradients
Clean props-based components with reactive HudData
weaknesses: ScreenInsets = DeviceSafeInsets ignores the top-bar safe area, so the pill can sit under the top bar
Caps of 4 description lines and 2 title lines truncate long quests

strengths: Placement is correct and respects the top-bar safe area
weaknesses: Shadows are a placeholder 9-slice image instead of two UIShadows
Extra glow image adds more art dependence
